'''Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek''' ({{IPA|pl|ˈvɔj.t͡ɕɛx ˈʂt͡ʂɛw̃s.nɘ̟ kat͡ʂˈma.rɛk|lang}}; 24 March 1942 – 26 May 2009) was a physicist and politician. From 1990 to 1998, he was the mayor of [[Poznań]], Poland.

== Biography ==
Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek was born on 24 March 1942 in [[Luboń]], [[Reichsgau Wartheland|Reich District of Wartheland]], [[Nazi Germany]] (now part of the [[Greater Poland Voivodeship]], Poland). His father, Telesfor Kaczmarek was of [[Poles (people)|Polish]] descent, and his mother, Zyta Kaczmarek (née ''Omaszt''), was of [[Hungarians|Hungarian]] descent. At the age of two, he got sick from [[polio]].<ref>Eugenia R. Dabertowa: ''Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek. Prezydent miasta Poznania czasów przełomu (1990–1998)''. In: ''Kronika Miasta Poznania'', issue 2. Poznań: Wydawnictwo Miejskie Posnania, 2016, p. 63–4, ISSN 0137-3552. (in Polish)</ref>

In 1966, Kaczmarek graduated from the Faculty of Physics of the [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań|Adam Mickiewicz University]] in [[Poznań]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=31691&_k=ywfzg2|title=Dr hab. Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek|website=nauka-polska.pl|language=pl}}</ref> He worked as a physicist until 1990, including at the [[ETH Zurich]], the [[Sorbonne Paris North University]], and the Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań.<ref name=rp>{{cite web|url=http://www.rp.pl/artykul/2,311363.html|title=Zmarł Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek|date=27 May 2009|website=rp.pl|language=pl|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130504005656/http://www.rp.pl/artykul/2,311363.html|archive-date=2013-05-04}}</ref>

In the 1980s, Kaczmarek was an activist in the [[Solidarity (Polish trade union)|Solidarity]] trade union. In 1990, he was elected by the city council as the mayor of [[Poznań]], with a difference of one vote. He took office on 6 June 1990, and following his reelection in 1994, he remained in office until 14 December 1998.<ref>Andrzej Wituski, Dorota Ronge-Juszczyk: ''Przecież to mój Poznań. Andrzej Wituski w rozmowie z Dorotą Ronge-Juszczyk'', Poznań: Dom Wydawniczy Rebis, 2014, p. 194–195, ISBN 978-83-7818-643-4, OCLC 903323433. (in Polish)</ref> He was a co-founder and a chairperson of the [[Association of Polish Cities]]. From 1990 to 2002, he was a member of the Poznań City Council. At the time, he belonged to the [[Freedom Union (Poland)|Freedom Union]]. In 2002, Kaczmarek unsuccessfully ran for office of the mayor of Poznań in a [[direct election]]. From 2000 to 2003, he was the consul-general of Poland in Paris.<ref name=rp/>

In 2004, Kaczmarek unsuccessfully run of office of a member of the [[European Parliament]], as a candidate of the [[Initiative for Poland]], and in 2005, he unsuccessfully run of office as a member of the [[Sejm|Sejm of Poland]], as a candidate of the [[Democratic Party – demokraci.pl|Democratic Party]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://codziennypoznan.pl/artykul/2017-03-24/75-lat-temu-urodzil-sie-wojciech-szczesny-kaczmarek/|website=codziennypoznan.pl|language=pl|date=24 March 2017|title=75 lat temu urodził się Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek}}</ref>

Kaczmarek died on 26 May 2009 in Poznań, and was buried at the [[Junikowo Cemetery]] in said city.<ref name=rp/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://gloswielkopolski.pl/wojciech-szczesny-kaczmarek-zostal-pochowany-na-junikowie/ar/125268|title=Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek został pochowany na Junikowie|website=gloswielkopolski.pl|language=pl|author=Bogna Kisiel|date=2 June 2009}}</ref> In 2011, a monument dedicated to him was unveiled at the Greater Poland Citizens Memorial Cemetery in Poznań.<ref>{{cite web |date=3 March 2011 |language=pl |title=Odsłonięcie pomnika Wojciecha Szczęsnego Kaczmarka |url=https://www.poznan.pl/mim/public/prezydent/news.html?co=print&id=43146&instance=1180&lang=pl |website=poznan.pl}}</ref>

== Awards and decorations ==
* [[Legion of Honour|National Order of the Legion of Honour]] (France, 1997)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.poznan.pl/mim/public/wiadmag/news.html?co=print&id=32126&instance=1016&lang=pl&parent=0|title=Zmarł Wojciech Szczęsny Kaczmarek|date=26 May 2009|website=poznan.pl|language=pl|archive-url=https://archive.today/20120913132338/http://www.poznan.pl/mim/public/wiadmag/news.html?co=print&id=32126&instance=1016&lang=pl&parent=0|archive-date=2012-09-13}}</ref>
* [[Order of Polonia Restituta|Officer's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta]] (Poland, 1999)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20000050099|title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 5 listopada 1999 r. o nadaniu orderów|language=pl|website=isap.sejm.gov.pl}}</ref>
* [[Order of Polonia Restituta|Commander's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta]] (Poland, 2009)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20090590799|title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 25 maja 2009 r. o nadaniu orderów|website=isap.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl}}</ref>
